module: Flowgraph node 'Timed Trigger' (logic category, behaviour once+duration). Flow must be held on 'charge' for data.duration seconds (3 by default) to trigger; if 'charge' is cut for more than data.resetTimer seconds (1 by default), the charge is reset to zero. Outputs: flow (while the charge is complete) and impulse 'complete' only once.
notes: Only data.duration is saved; resetTimer falls back to 1 on load (init value).
The input pin 'flow' is not read in work.

C.desc: Flowgraph node class (created by _flowgraph_createNode(C)). The methods are called by the flowgraph manager or the editor.

init.desc: Initializes resetTimer=1, duration=3 and the internal state.

updateCharge.desc: Increments timer (dtSim) when charge is active, fires completeTrigger at the duration; otherwise increments reset and resets the timer to zero after resetTimer.

drawMiddle.desc: Two progress bars (charge and reset) with remaining time.

work.desc: Calls updateCharge, flow = (timer >= duration), complete = impulse only once (completeReady).
